# Explicit successor decision input: COMMON_BODY_GRAMMARS.md

# Common closed body grammar decisions

OWNER-DELEGATED DESIGN DECISION OD-005. These definitions resolve representation gaps without creating extra canonical authority. They are successor design inputs, not an in-place reinterpretation of any historical kind/version. Affected bodies/material refs must be versioned before freezing exact schemas. Already-qualified unchanged bodies keep their original wire constraints.

## Scalars, sets and finite tags

SafeInteger: integer in [−9007199254740991,9007199254740991], never boolean/float. UInt: SafeInteger>=0. Revision: SafeInteger>=1. Int32: [−2147483648,2147483647]. No signed-64 range extension: the earlier proposal's signed-64 wording conflicts with immutable BDB-CJSON-1 and is superseded here. ID(kind): `<exact wire kind>_<uuidv4 lowercase>`; field names such as risk_id/assessment_id do not select another digest kind. Code: `[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,127}`. Text: 1..65536 Unicode scalar values, no normalization; explicitly nullable informational captures may use null. Lists max65536, semantic bodies max16MiB canonical UTF-8. Digest: exactly64 lowercase hex. No new identity algorithm.

TypedRef, RawRef, ExternalProfileRef, accepted HistoryCut, AcceptedHead and AcceptedEventRef retain the exact qualified predecessor representation. Kind/version is established jointly by wire kind and exact bound executable schema RawDigest; logical ID alone never selects a revision. A finite typed union names actual kind/version pairs; symbolic class names cannot be accepted as wire kinds. A HistoryCut is a value checked against history, not a newly synthesized object fact.

Reference sets use the inherited exact typed sort tuple `(kind, logical_id_or_empty, revision_digest, digest_profile, BDB-CJSON-1(schema_revision_ref))`, unless a new field explicitly uses tagged full-canonical-value ordering. This resolves the earlier proposals' conflicting full-JSON sorting wording without altering existing arrays. Commit immutable refs remain the original union-DAG topological sequence. Raw/profile/tagged union sets sort `(reference_tag,BDB-CJSON-1(full_ref))`. Text/code sets sort UTF-8 bytes; diagnostic/event sequences preserve captured order. No duplicate exact identity. Different schema identities with the same logical ID are different refs, not duplicate authority to merge.

ScopeSet: sorted nonempty exact TypedRefs to the finite active versions of surface_record, surface_key, invariant_revision, finding_claim_revision, coverage_obligation and scope_state_record. Empty scope cannot prove broad applicability. Where a body explicitly allows campaign-wide scope, its exact accepted inventory is an additional permitted target by that field's explicit contract; it is not added globally. Supporting/basis refs do not silently widen scope. Textual descriptions remain descriptions and never replace ScopeSet or known exact subject refs.

AuthorityRef uses the exact installation-authorized external principal/authority profile representation selected by TrustProfile, with exact principal/role/scope/issuer revision and no capability secret. An external authority pin is not a fabricated prior canonical fact. A field currently pretending it is a generic TypedRef/PRIOR_ACCEPTED_ONLY must have a successor reference contract that explicitly permits the installation-pinned representation. Principal identity and authority grant are distinct selected pins; caller possession of either encoding proves no authorization. Trusted control-plane checks occur at durable acceptance.

## Surface anchors

STATIC anchor is closed `{anchor_kind:"STATIC", member_path:CanonicalPOSIXPath, byte_offset:UInt, entry_kind:Code, discriminator:Text}`. Offset is zero-based in exact original source member bytes; bounds/member/source checked independently. RUNTIME anchor is closed `{anchor_kind:"RUNTIME", method:Code, route_pattern:Text, registration_origin:SourceAnchor, namespace:Code}`. SourceAnchor is closed `{source_manifest_ref:TypedRef(source_manifest), member_path:CanonicalPOSIXPath, start_byte:UInt, end_byte:UInt}`, with start<=end<=member length and exact source identity. Routes are captured canonical patterns from the exact collector capability; no heuristic route normalization establishes STABLE identity. Category codes are declared by the exact prior source/collector capability profile, not Python dictionaries. Unsupported/ambiguous anchor/category is PROVISIONAL and remains in unresolved accounting. SurfaceKey records identity only and is accepted before collector outputs; SurfaceRecord subsequently carries backward collector provenance. Its anchor/category/source must equal its referenced key.

CanonicalPOSIXPath for source-bound members/anchors/drift records: OD030 exact SOURCE_PATH_SHAPE, 1..512 Unicode scalar values, original hidden and Unicode names, nonempty segments, no `.`/`..`, backslash, leading/trailing slash or NUL. No case-fold/Unicode rewriting changes source identity; duplicate canonical aliases reject under the exact selected source profile. Generic package/transport paths retain the separately restricted ASCII grammar with initial alphanumeric. SourceDirectoryRef permits empty string only for the exact source-manifest root and otherwise selects the same source path shape. Actual execution independently resolves authorized directory membership and platform-safe containment; unsupported platform paths, drive-relative escape or outside-view symlink following reject without normalization or omission. A representable POSIX source name does not authorize using it as a host filesystem path.

## Contradictions and root causes

ContradictionPosition is closed `{claim_revision_ref:TypedRef(finding_claim_revision), statement:Text}`. Positions are sorted by full claim ref and statement bytes, no duplicates; each claim appears in the parent's complete claim_revision_refs and at least two distinct incompatible accepted claims/positions are required. Statements describe the asserted incompatibility; supporting/opposing qualified evidence remains separately bound by parent fields. Differences in failure assumptions/input environments are ordered Text descriptions of exact referenced evidence contexts; they establish no independent fact. required_falsifier is a prior installed purpose-specific METHOD contract pin, never executable supplied prose. Status is OPEN|TESTING|RESOLVED_SCOPED|RESOLVED_FULL|BLOCKED; resolved status requires prior exact resolution decision and scope equality. Future decision cannot resolve its input contradiction. Resolution produces a later immutable contradiction revision pointing to the prior decision.

RootCauseMembershipEdge retains §58's exact field spelling: closed `{finding_claim_revision_ref:TypedRef(finding_claim_revision), relation_role:SUPPORTS_CAUSE|CONTRIBUTES_TO_CAUSE|UNRESOLVED, scope:ScopeSet}`. Sort by `(full finding ref, relation_role, BDB-CJSON-1(scope))`, as §58 requires; complete typed refs are material. Repeated finding refs with different roles/scopes still require the pinned root-cause policy's explicit permission; absent permission rejects ambiguity. Edge membership never transfers severity or evidence strength. multi_causal_condition, when present, is Text describing the conjunction under exact scoped accepted membership/evidence, not an evaluated expression. Changed membership/condition/source creates a new revision and explicit backward predecessor refs. Historical root causes and findings never mutate.

ScopeKey is the closed tagged value `{scope_kind:"CANONICAL_SUBJECT",subject_ref:ScopeRef}` or `{scope_kind:"SOURCE_MEMBER",source_member:{source_manifest_ref,member_path}}`. It is not a mutable path authority: the latter binds exact accepted manifest membership. A ScopeStateRecord's optional scope_ref must match its selected exact subject; source-member scopes cannot claim a different canonical subject without independent accepted mapping. Same exact key identifies one denominator subject in a represented inventory. This closes an unspecified representation through a successor body; historical scope_key bytes retain their original reader.

AcceptedEventRef is exactly `{accepting_commit_hash:Digest,ordinal:UInt}`, matching §15 and §57. Event type and campaign are derived from the verified containing commit/event; they are not caller-selected duplicate fields. The ordinal is zero-based, in bounds, and the event must be accepted in the required cut. Contradiction status additionally includes REOPENED as §60 explicitly requires; reopening is a new immutable revision with prior predecessor and new evidence, never a mutation of the resolved revision.

## Execution/control and measurement structures

Positive/negative controls and falsifier requirements are exact prior ExperimentSpec refs in their explicit field-specific sets; a control result is a later accepted ExecutionResult ref. An ExperimentSpec cannot point to the future result of its own planned control. trigger/expected_safe_behavior/expected_buggy_behavior/falsification_condition remain bounded Text describing registered experimental intent; actual truth derives from authorized qualified observations/assessments. They cannot be evaluated as arbitrary Python/regex/expression text. ObservationPathRequirement is closed `{observation_kind:START|FINISH|MEASUREMENT|ACTIVATION|CLEANUP|RESET|CHANNEL_CAPTURE|EXTERNAL_WITNESS, capture_profile_ref:ExternalProfileRef, required:boolean}`. Captures match exact descriptor/source/producer context and profile. Profiles required for an experiment must be authorized before actual execution.

Environment fields filesystem_profile/network_profile/clock_profile/sandbox_profile, seed_profile and cleanup_spec are exact installed/planned ExternalProfileRefs to their field-specific closed contracts, not arbitrary dicts. environment/dependency/harness/fixture/context equality remains mandatory through intent→descriptor→capture→result→qualification. For cleanup/activation use finite exact observable equality from the separate raw-profile decision; unsupported scientific capture cannot receive default PASS.

LayerResult is closed `{layer:L1|L2|L3|L4|L5|L6|L7, result:PASS|FAIL|BLOCKED, reason_codes:Code[]}`. At most one per layer; ordered L1..L7; all applicable contract layers present. Overall PASS iff every required layer PASS. Any FAIL gives FAIL, otherwise missing/BLOCKED gives BLOCKED. Syntax/RawDigest validation is not L5 producer authority or L7 completion.

ModelState/ModelValue/SourceAnchor/ModelBound and reduced Rational retain the exact finite model/raw grammar and ADR rules. ModelBound is closed `{bound:STATES|TRANSITIONS|PATH_STEPS, limit:UInt}`; PATH_STEPS positive, all <=65536, sorted by bound. Model fidelity copies of declared omissions/assumptions/bounds must equal exact model raw, never caller-reduced scope. ImplementationAnchor refs are the closed prior SourceAnchor values; abstraction mapping refs are retained exact raw mapping, with complete symbol/transition correspondence.

## Projection summaries and slot bindings

LaneSlotResult is closed `{slot_contract_ref:ExternalProfileRef, lane_completion_ref:TypedRef(lane_completion)}`. Sorted by full slot pin then completion ref; no duplicate slot. Each completion must be prior accepted, match the required StageSpec slot/run/source and fulfill all lane predicates. A result object cannot substitute for LaneCompletion.

MandatoryObligationSummary is closed `{obligation_refs:TypedRef(coverage_obligation)[], qualification_refs:TypedRef(coverage_obligation_qualification)[], applicability_decision_refs:TypedRef(obligation_applicability_decision)[], waiver_decision_refs:TypedRef(approval_decision)[]}`. Every set equals independent complete applicable derivation at input cut; it is a checked projection, not a second coverage authority. UnknownBlockedSummary is closed `{unknown_refs:TypedRef[], blocked_refs:TypedRef[], invalidated_refs:TypedRef[], unresolved_contradiction_refs:TypedRef(contradiction_revision)[]}` with each field's finite target set frozen in the schema/reference contract. Lists may be empty only by proved exhaustive derivation. A vague text or count does not replace exact blocker facts. StopInput evidence_invalidation_state is the sorted complete exact EvidenceInvalidation ref set and equality-binds its authority array; it grants no separate state or seal.

ClosedPurposePayload, ReportObject, ReportBinding, BundleMember and ComponentEntry follow the raw-boundary design's exact finite forms. ReportObject body is checked against its exact qualified schema and equality with durable canonical object; no arbitrary unvalidated JSON value. ComponentEntry is `{member_path:CanonicalPOSIXPath, raw_ref:RawRef, component_role:CODE|SCHEMA|SPEC|PROMPT|FIXTURE}` with unique sorted paths and full expected membership. Snapshots, exports and payload manifests do not replace accepted history or independently qualify builds.

## Compatibility, drift and transition proposals

Compatibility observed/expected result is a closed tagged transport observation `{outcome:ACCEPT|REJECT|BLOCKED, output_raw_ref:RawRef|null}`. Raw output is mandatory for material result payload and independently compared under exact fixture contract; missing output is explicitly null. Error-family codes remain optional only when no error exists. known_legacy_bug is boolean and requires an independently established expectation/hardening basis, never current-result inference. Counts are derived exact denominator partition; unqualified fixtures do not disappear. Preservation PASS and correctness PASS remain separate.

ChangedManifestMember is closed `{member_path:CanonicalPOSIXPath, change:ADDED|REMOVED|MODIFIED|TYPE_CHANGED}`; sorted unique path, exact diff of old/new accepted manifests. Optional dependency_profile_change is closed `{old_profile_ref:ExternalProfileRef, new_profile_ref:ExternalProfileRef}` and must independently differ with proved applicability consequences. No mtime/path cache/source-generation label substitutes for bytes.

TransitionProposal.allowed_next_transition is closed `{aggregate_kind:CAMPAIGN|STAGE_RUN|LANE_RUN|ATTEMPT, from_state:Code, to_state:Code, event_type:Code}` constrained to the exact pinned transition table. proposal_parent_head is AcceptedHead. expiry_or_single_use_policy is literal SINGLE_ACCEPTED_TRANSITION_AT_EXACT_PARENT; wall-clock expiry cannot create ordering authority. Proposal is not a minted executor capability, future approval or accepted transition. Accepted use requires prior checkpoint/gate/knowledge and current trusted actor eligibility.

## Version and migration obligation

This design resolves fields, not their historical authority. New closed representations that change canonical bytes/meaning/material refs create successor versions. References to changed versions are propagated through each affected parent's exact reference contract, including schemas/profiles/installation/bootstrap as needed. Propagation is a finite work queue, never implicit aliasing. Original kinds/versions remain historical readers with original exact schemas; fresh successor campaigns explicitly select qualified active versions. No retroactive bindings, approvals, equivalent-package acceptance or fabricated chronology.

## Explicit corrections to previous raw-boundary profile proposals

The legacy mechanical-validation successor replaces its open parsed facts bag with exactly `{variant:Text|null,stage:Text|null}`. The exact original legacy parser/profile supplies explicit RFC6901 extraction paths and finite original variant/stage domains; absent values are null and cannot establish VALID where required. Raw original legacy bytes remain retained, and other original fields are not promoted into current authority. SourceReconciliation's raw_identifiers successor is `{claims:RawIdentifierEntry[]}`, with entries `{identifier_kind:ARCHIVE_NAME|DECLARED_GIT_COMMIT|DECLARED_GIT_TREE|DECLARED_SOURCE_ID|DECLARED_MANIFEST_RAW_DIGEST,value:Text}`. The exact pinned import profile enumerates extraction paths; the list must equal all extracted identity assertions, sorted by kind/value, with duplicates rejected. A label/digest assertion does not establish repository authority or byte equivalence; actual reconciliation independently resolves original bytes and the exact authorized SourceIdentity. Conflicting assertions reject or produce the defined non-success assessment. ViewManifest's metadata_projection successor is the closed empty object `{}`: no arbitrary descriptive metadata is released by this profile. Exact allowed-member RawRefs, positive-view policy, metadata knowledge preflight and original grant/exposure requirements remain conjunctive. A future nonempty metadata format requires its own explicit versioned disclosure contract.

CLEANUP_ASSESSMENT_V2 is closed `{profile_id:"CLEANUP_ASSESSMENT_V2", descriptor_selection:"EXACT_CLEANUP_SUBJECT_DESCRIPTOR", required_checks:CleanupCheck[]}`; checks retain their exact previous finite grammar. There is no execution_descriptor_ref in the installed profile. The CleanupResult body's prior descriptor selects the exact accepted ExperimentSpec and its preregistered cleanup profile; wrong-profile/subject mismatch rejects. TOOL_CAPTURE_V2 is closed `{profile_id:"TOOL_CAPTURE_V2", capture_code_ref:RawRef, experiment_selection:"EXACT_DESCRIPTOR_EXPERIMENT", environment_profile_ref:ExternalProfileRef, output_contract_refs:ExternalProfileRef[]}`; no authorized_experiment_refs backlink. Trusted producer/capture authorization is independently checked through prior descriptor/experiment and exact installed trust context, not profile possession. These are versioned corrections to old proposed profiles, whose bytes remain immutable historical design evidence.

# Explicit successor decision input: PURPOSE_PREDICATE_CONTRACTS.md

# Purpose-specific predicate contract decisions

OWNER-DELEGATED DESIGN DECISION OD-003. Design input for the successor, not yet a qualified installed profile. Each family has one fixed algorithm, a closed input domain, a closed policy-parameter domain, finite output states and the rules below. No expression/eval field, arbitrary checker name, embedded secret, caller `trusted` flag or unspecified success fallback is permitted. Profile changes require a new exact installed revision; changed canonical bodies/reference contracts require kind version successors.

## Shared execution and identity obligations

The predicate evaluator receives a verified accepted HistoryCut and exact subject reference, dereferences the complete specified input closure from history, reads retained raw dependencies and resolves every profile/schema through that campaign's qualified installation context. Caller supplied resolved bodies, scalar statuses, digests and summaries are compared with independent derivation and never substitute for it. Every authority ref must be visible at its declared cut. Context/profile roots must predate the operation; allowed content refs obey their explicit object ordering contract. Terminal transitions and delivery authorization are serialized against the same accepted head. A cut can be old only for a explicitly pinned historical assessment, with independent applicability revalidation before current consumption.

A profile instance is closed `{profile_id, algorithm_id, parameters}`. `profile_id` and `algorithm_id` are constants per family below. Parameters have exactly the listed fields, no others. Their typed refs are installation-authorized/planned before use, not newly asserted authority. Integers are BDB safe integers; counts and resource limits are nonnegative and <=9007199254740991; text/code lists are finite sorted unique sets, max65536 entries. Resources are exactly CPU_TIME_US, WALL_TIME_US, MEMORY_BYTES, OUTPUT_BYTES, FILE_COUNT. Missing parameters reject profile installation; evaluation must not use defaults. Empty required sets are legal only where the pinned subject spec independently declares none. JSON float, duplicate key, unknown enum, malformed ref or unsupported parameter rejects before canonical acceptance. Resource exhaustion produces unavailable/blocked output, never partial success.

For each successful computed output, the canonical object's proposed output must equal it. Negative evaluation may be retained as a truthful eligible assessment/decision, but a proposed success object fails. A rejected canonical operation makes no change to head, commits, events, immutable objects, receipts, indexes, selectors or accepted raw refs. Any separately staged raw is nonauthoritative until the legal operation accepts its reference. A runtime capability is an unexported security primitive, never canonical evidence.

## STAGE — STAGE_COMPLETION_V1

Inputs: exact StageRun, its StageSpec, input cut; independently selected required LaneCompletion objects, complete required output slot bindings, source-bound inventory/accounting, applicable obligations/qualifications and material unresolved facts at that cut. Output: SATISFIED, VIOLATED, UNKNOWN, BLOCKED. Parameters: `{spec_selection:"EXACT_STAGE_RUN_REF", completion_output_kind_versions:SchemaKey[], required_qualification_status:"QUALIFIED"}`. Keys are exact versioned schema keys from the qualified installation. Each StageRun selects its exact accepted StageSpec; the predicate profile does not contain a backlink to its future StageSpec consumer.

SATISFIED iff (1) StageRun is in COMPLETION_CANDIDATE; (2) each required StageSpec lane slot has exactly one applicable accepted LaneCompletion with matching run/spec/source/slot; (3) independently enumerated outputs equal the complete required outputs, including E5A candidate and E5B both challengers where the actual StageSpec requires them; (4) all mandatory applicable investigation obligations have current eligible QUALIFIED assessments satisfying their exact acceptance/control/applicability predicates; (5) accounting is terminal, knowledge/isolation/disclosure checks are satisfied; (6) no material unresolved contradiction, required unknown scope, stale/invalidation or required unavailable witness remains. Confirming a defect may satisfy investigation and does not mean release readiness. Optional lanes never fill missing required slots. STOP/conclusion/final/release/public statement are not stage completion prerequisites. VIOLATED for established binding/FSM/predicate mismatch; BLOCKED for a recorded execution/resource blocker; UNKNOWN for missing/unverifiable required fact. No waiver/risk acceptance turns a required investigation into performed work.

## LANE — LANE_COMPLETION_V1

Inputs: exact LaneRun/LaneSpec, Attempt lineage, assignment/binding/STARTED/admission/result chain for each selected result slot, final KnowledgeState, complete outputs, IsolationQualification and ContaminationAssessments. Output: SATISFIED, VIOLATED, UNKNOWN, BLOCKED. Parameters: `{spec_selection:"EXACT_LANE_RUN_REF", allowed_result_kind_versions:SchemaKey[], required_isolation_results:(ENFORCED|DECLARED)[]}`. No UNKNOWN isolation eligibility; the selected LaneSpec can require stricter enforcement.

SATISFIED iff eligible lane FSM, every required exact slot has one accepted result with prior evidence and independently retained normalization, required outputs equal slot contracts, all attempts/source/profile/cuts agree, final knowledge/exposure policy is satisfied, isolation meets the exact LaneSpec and every required contamination result is CLEAN or a separately justified policy-permitted NOT_APPLICABLE. Result existence is one conjunct only. Forked attempt/slot selectors, late result into completed lane, wrong binding and cross-lane reused evidence are VIOLATED. Missing witness is UNKNOWN; actual blocker BLOCKED. Exact retry returns original fact, never reselects a latest attempt.

## EXECUTOR — EXECUTOR_ELIGIBILITY_V1

Inputs: exact accepted ExecutorSpec, planned descriptor/assignment, source/env/dependency/runner pins, installation-authorized capture capability, complete current channel/isolating witnesses. Output: ELIGIBLE, INELIGIBLE, UNKNOWN, BLOCKED. Parameters: `{required_capabilities:Code[], required_channel_classes:Code[], executor_selection:"EXACT_ASSIGNMENT_OR_DESCRIPTOR_CONTEXT", require_fresh_session:boolean}`. Channel codes must equal a subset of the exact isolation baseline domain; unknown channels reject the profile.

ELIGIBLE requires all required capabilities, installation-authorized exact tool/model/runtime/boundary identities, actual invocation equality to planned execution, current session freshness where required, no forbidden knowledge under accepted grants and complete applicable isolation witnesses. Merely running another model/process establishes no independence. INELIGIBLE for known forbidden/mismatched context, BLOCKED for unavailable authorized execution resource, UNKNOWN for unproven capability/isolation. A declared capability is not an enforcement witness.

## DELIVERY — NF02_DELIVERY_AUTHORIZATION_V1

Inputs: prior exact AssignmentManifest, unique AssignmentPackageBinding, durable package RawRef readback, accepted AttemptStarted, current aggregate state/knowledge/exposure grants and exact DeliverySpec. Output: ALLOW, DENY, UNKNOWN, BLOCKED. Parameters: `{delivery_selection:"EXACT_ASSIGNMENT_CONTEXT", require_binding:true, require_started:true, raw_source:"DURABLE_RAW_VAULT", retry_mode:"EXACT_AUTHORIZED_BYTES"}`.

ALLOW requires every input guard, current eligible attempt and source/profile identity. Read bytes only through accepted binding→durable raw; validate exact digest/length and package transport/semantic context. A workspace file, cached digest or equivalent repack cannot select content. Before binding+STARTED acceptance, callbacks/file export/executor access are zero. A competing terminal transition wins serialization or cancels access; delivery cannot grant after terminal state. Durable missing/corrupt bytes BLOCKED; wrong authority/context DENY; unverified guard UNKNOWN. Retries deliver retained identical authorized bytes under the same guard or fail closed. No fallback to workspace.

## COLLECTOR — COLLECTOR_ACCOUNTING_V1

Inputs: prior source manifest/capability, declared prior SurfaceKeys/manual witness observations, trusted exact invocation/output capture, collector raw and proposed semantic wrapper. Output: ACCOUNTED, INCOMPLETE, BLOCKED. Parameters: `{assigned_input_policy:"ALL_MANIFEST_MEMBERS", output_identity:"PRIOR_SURFACE_KEYS", terminal_dispositions:["COLLECTED","UNSUPPORTED","EXCLUDED","COLLECTION_FAILED","PARSING_FAILED"], exclusion_decision_type:"SCOPE_EXCLUSION"}`. The disposition array is an exact sorted set of these constants.

ACCOUNTED requires complete independently read raw normalization, exactly one terminal disposition per exact source member, all errors/limits retained, declared outputs exactly prior SurfaceKeys with legitimate backward provenance, authorized prior exclusions only. Unsupported/failed members remain in the inventory denominator with their scope states. ACCOUNTED is never coverage PASS. Later SurfaceRecords reference accepted collector, never the other direction. Missing/PROVISIONAL disposition yields INCOMPLETE; actual unavailable capture/raw/resource gives BLOCKED. False success body rejects.

## METHOD — METHOD_QUALIFICATION_V2

Inputs: prior ExperimentSpec/ExecutionDescriptor, retained observations, execution/control/cleanup facts, dependency graph and current claim-relative applicability/independence qualification. Output: QUALIFIED, REFUTED, INCONCLUSIVE, BLOCKED. Parameters: `{method_type:STATIC_ANALYSIS|DYNAMIC|FAULT_INJECTION|FUZZ|PROPERTY|DIFFERENTIAL|METAMORPHIC|STATEFUL|CONCURRENCY|ENDURANCE|IMPLEMENTATION_MUTATION|ORACLE_CHALLENGE|MODEL_CONFORMANCE|REPLAY, control_selection:"EXACT_PRIOR_SUBJECT_EXPERIMENT_CONTROLS", required_observation_kinds:Code[], required_independence_dimensions:Code[]}`. Observation codes and independence dimensions are exact Data §46/§48 domains. Policy cannot add a method by a string. Controls are derived from the subject's exact prior ExperimentSpec positive_controls/negative_controls and actual corresponding executions, not pinned as future experiment facts inside the installation profile. Complete method-specific controls remain mandatory; a subject declaring fewer controls than the method requires is INCONCLUSIVE/BLOCKED, never QUALIFIED. This V2 avoids the Policy→context→method-profile→future-experiment→Policy chronology cycle. The V1 analysis label is navigation only; the final runtime pin is exact V2.

QUALIFIED means the selected method's investigation requirements are actually established, independently of whether a defect was found. Preregistration requires accepted intent before actual execution; exploratory/legacy execution cannot obtain it retroactively. All expected observations and controls must exist and match scope/input/descriptor. Fault requires independent activation; ENDURANCE requires observed workload/duration and monitoring completeness; MODEL_CONFORMANCE requires prior applicable fidelity and actual conformance witnesses; replay alone provides no independence. IMPLEMENTATION_MUTATION and ORACLE_CHALLENGE use their distinct §68 enums; oracle qualification requires all four exact clean/defective × strong/weakened cases, qualified activation and actual outcome derivation. Clean PASS alone never establishes weakening detection. Established contrary expected predicate yields REFUTED; ambiguous/missing evidence INCONCLUSIVE; actual blocker BLOCKED. A human scientific assessment remains an authorized ASSESSMENT of exact support, not an arbitrary executable expression or declaration of product truth.

## CONFIRMATION — DISCOVERY_CONFIRMATION_V1

Inputs: exact DiscoveryRecord, complete accepted supporting/refuting EvidenceQualifications with current applicability and their exact experiments/observations; cut. Output: CONFIRMED, NOT_CONFIRMED, INCONCLUSIVE, BLOCKED. Parameters: `{permitted_modes:(PREREGISTERED|EXPLORATORY|LEGACY_IMPORTED)[], require_current_applicability:true, require_exact_discovery_scope:true}`.

Every evidence entry must address the exact discovery mechanism/scope under an authorized confirmation assessment. CONFIRMED requires decisive SUPPORTS and no unresolved decisive REFUTES/contradiction; NOT_CONFIRMED requires decisive REFUTES with no unresolved decisive support; mixed, missing or inconclusive support yields INCONCLUSIVE. Blocked required execution yields BLOCKED. Preregistered mode requires prior intent; imports preserve their mode. Confirmation does not establish blindness, novelty or adjudicated finding truth. A caller matching strings does not establish that evidence is about the discovery.

## MATCHING — EXACT_SCOPED_MATCH_V1

Inputs: DiscoveryRecord or FindingClaimRevision, every eligible prior member in the exact pinned CorpusManifest, their current source/scope/invariant/mechanism facts and any already accepted authorized finding-to-defect matching assessment. Output: MATCH, NO_MATCH, PARTIAL, INCONCLUSIVE. Parameters: `{candidate_policy:"ALL_ELIGIBLE_MEMBERS", exact_match_rule:"EXACT_SUBJECT_SCOPE_INVARIANT_AND_MECHANISM", unknown_overlap:"INCONCLUSIVE", require_complete_corpus:true}`.

Exact subject source identity, complete canonical scope identity set, exact violated invariant revision set and exact canonical mechanism/claim statement bytes establish an exact match. An eligible previously accepted matching assessment may establish a scientifically assessed match only for its exact pair/cut and current qualified support; name similarity or edit distance cannot. NO_MATCH requires a complete search in which every candidate is proved disjoint by exact scope/invariant applicability; differing prose does not prove disjointness. Established match plus unresolved overlapping candidates gives PARTIAL; possible unresolved semantic overlap or incomplete corpus gives INCONCLUSIVE. No search truncation, outcome filter or favorable subset. This conservative algorithm permits genuine unknowns instead of inventing semantic equivalence.

## NOVELTY — CORPUS_RELATIVE_NOVELTY_V1

Inputs: prior exact matching assessment for the same discovery/corpus and cut-applicable history. Output: NOVEL, PREVIOUSLY_KNOWN, PARTIALLY_NOVEL, INCONCLUSIVE. Parameters: `{basis:"EXACT_PINNED_CORPUS", missing_basis:"INCONCLUSIVE"}`.

Complete NO_MATCH maps to NOVEL; complete MATCH to PREVIOUSLY_KNOWN; established matched and independently established unmatched subscopes in a PARTIAL assessment map to PARTIALLY_NOVEL; all incomplete/ambiguous cases map to INCONCLUSIVE. No statement about universal novelty or blind provenance follows. A different matching subject/corpus or stale material basis rejects, not INCONCLUSIVE acceptance under the wrong identity.

## RELATIONSHIP — PRIOR_FALSE_NEGATIVE_V1

Inputs: exact confirmed discovery, prior StageCompletion/claim, mandatory applicable prior coverage obligation and its eligible investigation scope, actual missed result/adjudication and current discovery qualification. Output: PREVIOUS_FALSE_NEGATIVE, MULTI_STAGE_FALSE_NEGATIVE, NOT_ESTABLISHED, INCONCLUSIVE. Parameters: `{minimum_prior_stages:positive safe integer, scope_rule:"EXACT_REQUIRED_APPLICABLE_SCOPE", unknown_rule:"INCONCLUSIVE"}`.

A prior stage counts only if it was required to investigate the exact issue's applicable scope and accepted completed investigation without identifying it; actual current decisive confirmation and source applicability are required. If the count meets minimum_prior_stages, one established stage gives PREVIOUS_FALSE_NEGATIVE and two or more distinct established stage identities give MULTI_STAGE_FALSE_NEGATIVE; a positive established count below the required minimum gives INCONCLUSIVE. Proved scope absence gives NOT_ESTABLISHED, not an accusation of missed coverage. Missing/unverifiable prior obligation or discovery basis gives INCONCLUSIVE. Counts are independently derived distinct stage refs; threshold cannot turn incomplete evidence into a confirmed relationship.

## ASSESSOR — CLAIM_RELATIVE_ASSESSMENT_V1

OD035 extends this still-unqualified planned family with the exact materiality_assessment successor key, retaining the original finding/calibration branches. For materiality the input is the exact surface/key/invariant/scope subject, represented input cut, exact governing materiality PolicyRevision, complete declared scope and applicable independently accepted supporting/opposing facts. The finite output is MATERIAL|NON_MATERIAL|UNKNOWN|CONFLICTED. The exact assessment kind selects this branch; it cannot reuse a finding-axis/calibration output domain or treat UNKNOWN/CONFLICTED as NON_MATERIAL. The authorized assessor issues the judgment; the validator checks actor/scope/policy/context authorization and complete applicable basis, without creating truth from vote counts, profile possession, collector exit or a scalar status. Changed judgment is a new immutable assessment and cannot rewrite a historical denominator. Concurrent/competing applicable assessments require explicit policy-authorized resolution; no latest logical-ID selection or implicit supersession. Missing/unverified materiality remains UNKNOWN/unresolved in every consumer. No new purpose or parallel policy authority is introduced.

For the original finding/calibration branches, inputs are: exact claim or calibration opportunity, authorized assessor principal/profile at cut, qualified observations/evidence, accepted ground truth where applicable, complete subject scope and opposing evidence. Their output domains remain the exact selected assessment contract: M/R/I SUPPORTED|REFUTED|INCONCLUSIVE|BLOCKED|NOT_APPLICABLE; severity CRITICAL|HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW|INFO with confidence HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW|UNKNOWN; calibration MATCH|NO_MATCH|PARTIAL|UNRESOLVED or TRUE_NEGATIVE|FALSE_POSITIVE|UNRESOLVED|BLOCKED. Parameters shared with the separate OD035 materiality branch: `{assessment_kind_version:SchemaKey, authorized_principal_refs:ExternalProfileRef[], require_current_applicability:true, require_opposing_evidence_accounting:true}`. Principal authorization pins are external authority context, not references to future assessor facts.

The assessment-specific domain is selected by an exact finite installed schema key; it cannot be caller-inferred from a generic `result`. Adjudication axes remain separate and scope/claim/cut bound. The validator verifies authorized production, complete qualified basis and applicability; scientific judgment must be issued by that authorized assessor and may remain INCONCLUSIVE. Ground truth comes from a prior independently authorized corpus, never the tested auditor output, majority, match count or producer string. Severity is an assessed dimension, not copied caller-reported severity. NOT_APPLICABLE requires exact separate applicable policy/decision; unsupported target/profile rejects. An assessor's authorization never upgrades evidence strength or overrides an unresolved material contradiction.

## MODEL — FINITE_MODEL_FIDELITY_V1

Inputs: exact StateModel raw, complete source mapping, prior source generation, bounded exploration witnesses and execution conformance qualifications. Output: QUALIFIED, BOUNDED, INSUFFICIENT, INVALIDATED. Parameters: `{max_states:positive safe integer<=65536, max_transitions:safe integer<=65536, max_path_steps:positive safe integer<=65536, require_complete_mapping:true, require_implementation_conformance:boolean}`.

Use the finite state grammar in ADDITIONAL_PROFILE_CONTRACT_PROPOSALS, with exact typed state values (true !=1), listed transitions only and deterministic reachability fixed point/bounds. Complete mapping of every variable/transition and explicit omissions/assumptions is mandatory. Invalidated/mismatched source mapping gives INVALIDATED. Missing mapping/exploration/conformance gives INSUFFICIENT. A sound bounded declared model with disclosed limits gives BOUNDED. QUALIFIED for an implementation claim additionally requires current qualified conformance witnesses and claim-scoped fidelity; no proof transfer from model-only success. Exceeding any declared resource bound is unavailable evidence, never truncated QUALIFIED.

## FAULT — QUALIFIED_ACTIVATION_V1

Inputs: prior exact FaultSpec/descriptor, installation-authorized activation capture predicate, all planned targets and retained activation/cleanup observations. Output: ACTIVATED, NOT_ACTIVATED, PARTIALLY_ACTIVATED, BLOCKED, HARNESS_FAILURE. Parameters: `{activation_check_refs:RawRef(CLEANUP_EXPECTED_OBSERVABLE_V1)[], required_cleanup_profile_ref:ExternalProfileRef, require_all_targets:true}`. Activation uses the same finite exact capture equality grammar, not arbitrary eval.

Every declared target requires a trusted correctly scoped captured observable matching its preregistered activation check. All match→ACTIVATED; none match with complete valid capture→NOT_ACTIVATED; proper subset match→PARTIALLY_ACTIVATED. Missing required resource/capture→BLOCKED, malformed/failed harness capture→HARNESS_FAILURE. Missing observations do not mean NOT_ACTIVATED. Actual cleanup assessment remains separate. Raw plus caller status and matching digest cannot establish activation. Neither partial nor unactivated fault satisfies an activation-required obligation.

## RELEASE — FINAL_CHAIN_RELEASE_V1

Inputs: accepted Conclusion→STOP→StopInput, prior FinalAssuranceCase, exact source, complete current release-relevant findings/risks/approvals, release basis and previous qualification only for reassessment. Output: READY, READY_WITH_RESIDUAL_RISK, TECHNICALLY_NOT_READY, QUALIFICATION_BLOCKED. Parameters: `{blocking_severity_values:(CRITICAL|HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW|INFO)[], permitted_risk_acceptance_authority_refs:ExternalProfileRef[], require_completed_pass:true, require_adequate_declared_scope:true}`. Empty blocking severities do not waive independently mandatory release predicates.

All finalization bindings are exact equalities. Missing final case/current basis→QUALIFICATION_BLOCKED. Limited/non-PASS/insufficient audit cannot give either READY state. Established blocking finding/risk→TECHNICALLY_NOT_READY. Required unknown/stale/invalidated basis→QUALIFICATION_BLOCKED. Complete eligible full final chain and independently satisfied release predicates gives READY only with no applicable release-material residual risk; otherwise READY_WITH_RESIDUAL_RISK requires a prior exact separately authorized approval for every such risk, without waiving unsatisfied mandatory investigation. STOP_AXIS_MATERIALIZATION copies the STOP release axis only if no material release input/policy drift since its cut; first changed release-specific basis uses FRESH_RELEASE_QUALIFICATION without fabricated predecessor; subsequent qualification uses RELEASE_REASSESSMENT with exact prior ref. Audit-invalidating drift requires legally triggered successor campaign.

## EFFORT — OBSERVED_EFFORT_V2

Inputs: complete applicable accepted stage/execution/observation/discovery/root-cause/obligation/challenger histories at exact cut, planned per-stage required rounds/methods/resources and observed metric witnesses. Output: SATISFIED, INSUFFICIENT_DATA, BLOCKED; saturation separately LOW|MODERATE|STRONG|INSUFFICIENT_DATA, never completeness. Parameters: `{stage_selection:"EXACT_REQUIRED_STAGE_SET_AT_INPUT_CUT", stage_requirements:StageEffortRequirement[]}` where each closed requirement is `{stage_ordinal:integer(0..65536), minimum_rounds:positive safe integer, required_method_types:MethodType[], minimum_observed_work_units:safe integer, work_unit:EXECUTIONS|SOURCE_MEMBERS|OBSERVED_WORKLOAD_UNITS}`. Sort requirements by stage_ordinal, rejecting duplicate ordinals. Independently resolve the complete exact required StageSpec reference set at the input cut and apply each matching ordinal threshold to every required exact spec. The ordinal indexes configuration only; it cannot select history or authorize a spec. Every required spec must have one matching threshold; absent or ambiguous coverage yields INSUFFICIENT_DATA. Applicable rounds/work are derived separately for each exact spec/campaign/source, including legitimate same-ordinal successor runs, with no latest-by-ID lookup or cross-spec aggregation. Requirements for conditionally nonrequired stages cannot add those stages to authority. This V2 removes profile backlinks to future accepted StageSpecs; exact spec identities remain in independently resolved accepted context. The V1 analysis label is navigation only, never a runtime alias.

Round is a distinct accepted StageRun/Attempt exploration iteration explicitly identified by exact planned lineage, not upload retries. An execution work unit counts one exact eligible completed descriptor; source work counts distinct terminally accounted manifest members; workload counts independently captured integer units from required retained MEASUREMENT observations. Retries never double count. Required method coverage uses actual qualified Method facts, not names in a proposed output. Missing clock/workload/method/capture witnesses gives INSUFFICIENT_DATA, actual resource prevention BLOCKED. Only all applicable thresholds met gives SATISFIED. No history subset or assumed-zero metric. Rational rates use exact reduced numerator/positive denominator, unknown counts remain explicit; saturation never discharges scope/obligation/challenge guards.

## RECOVERY — EXACT_DURABLE_RECOVERY_V1

Inputs: exact stored accepted head/commit chain, immutable object/schema/profile closure, accepted raw refs, receipts/command indexes, external anchor only where trust requires it. Output: VERIFIED, CORRUPT, UNAVAILABLE. Parameters: `{receipt_policy:"RECONSTRUCT_FROM_ACCEPTED_COMMIT", raw_policy:"READBACK_ALL_ACCEPTED_REFS", head_policy:"EXACT_CHAIN", anchor_policy:LOCAL|EXTERNAL_REQUIRED}`.

VERIFIED requires complete consistent commit/object/raw closure and exact installed predecessor/current contract interpretation for every campaign; source and authoritative selectors are replayed from accepted events. Rebuildable indexes/receipts may be reconstructed only from that exact accepted chain and command identity, never workspace/cache. Each crashed operation yields complete durable accepted closure or no accepted operation. Missing required bytes/anchor→UNAVAILABLE; digest/length/chain/conflicting receipt/head mismatch→CORRUPT. Neither permits canonical resume/write/export until restored identical bytes are independently verified or an existing authorized recovery transition applies. No new binding/result/history is synthesized. Old campaigns remain readable with original exact contracts and cannot accept successor writes.

FULL_PATH_CONTEXT_PARAMETERS successor must bind each actual owner field to one of these exact purpose contracts and its finite kind/version inputs, output domain, current/prior cut rule and parameter schema. The sixteen fixed algorithms additionally have named finite input-view schemas in PURPOSE_CONTRACT_GRAMMARS.input_domain, preserving the full source requirements above. # Explicit successor decision input: COMMAND_EVENT_CONTRACT.md

# Closed successor command and event bodies

OWNER-DELEGATED DESIGN DECISION OD-016. Data §§14–16 and §192 remain the semantic basis. Existing command_envelope/1 and commit_body/1 schemas permit unspecified object payloads; their successor bodies close these representations. This document is design input, not qualification or runtime authority.

The successor CommandEnvelope requires inline command_payload and forbids command_payload_ref. The payload is exactly `{proposed_object_refs:TypedRef[],events:EventBody[]}`. Proposed refs name the complete new fact/content closure supplied to acceptance, excluding the command itself, its accepting CommitBody and receipt. Referenced bodies are independently available, hash/schema checked, and union-DAG sorted. Payload references authorize neither their own producer nor a prior-only requirement. An empty proposed list is legal only for an independently legal transition command with prior basis. There is no arbitrary nested instruction bag or serialized capability. Governing policy/spec/actor/parent stay in the original envelope fields and cannot be contradicted by payload.

Four exact command_kind values: INITIALIZE_CAMPAIGN_FROM_LEGACY, ACCEPT_ARTIFACTS, TRANSITION, INGEST_EXTERNAL_LANE_RESULT. Initialization retains the original empty-parent/namespace/profile/proposed-campaign contract. Every other command requires the exact prior campaign/parent and forbids initialization-only fields. ACCEPT_ARTIFACTS is generic dispatch, never generic permission: every fact's own producer/schema/ref/FSM predicates apply at the durable boundary. TRANSITION cannot supply unrelated new canonical facts and requires complete prior transition basis. INGEST_EXTERNAL_LANE_RESULT requires the mechanically authorized external ingestion boundary in addition to all admission predicates; selecting the string proves no trust. Exact retries reuse the original receipt. Changing payload/ID conflicts without mutation.

EventBody is a finite closed union. Data §16's named artifact acceptance events have exactly `{event_type,artifact_ref}`, with the exact target kind from the explicit event table. ArtifactAccepted admits any active fact kind only under its own complete contract; command/commit/receipt/installation trust roots cannot be laundered through it. GateEvaluated has exactly `{event_type,target_ref,result_ref}`; target and decision/assessment result must match the independently validated gate context. No event name is a canonical kind alias.

InstallationRootPinned is an additional closed event `{event_type:"InstallationRootPinned",artifact_ref}` available only in the first initialization commit for the independently qualified exact installation-root facts. It records admission of already externally authorized bytes; it does not create their authority. Every target must equal its external qualified installation pin before validation of the command, including exact schema, policy, spec and trust context. A same-commit root extension or different bytes reject. This event closes bootstrap accounting without allowing generic artifact dispatch to install arbitrary trust roots.

AttemptStarted is a dedicated closed event `{event_type:"AttemptStarted",attempt_ref,assignment_ref,package_binding_ref}`. All three refs are prior accepted before the command, exact assignment/attempt/source/spec compatible, and binding is unique and raw-durable. It derives exactly CREATED→STARTED under the current parent and all existing grants/isolation/source guards. No other event can start an Attempt or imply delivery.

StateTransitionAccepted is a new explicitly registered **event envelope**, not a canonical object kind: `{event_type:"StateTransitionAccepted",aggregate_kind,aggregate_ref,from_state,to_state,basis_refs}`. Aggregate kind is CAMPAIGN|STAGE_RUN|LANE_RUN|ATTEMPT; exact typed aggregate ref is prior accepted and state is independently replayed from history. The state pair must belong to the complete unchanged normative §14 table. basis_refs is the exact prior fact set required by the selected transition predicate; extra/missing/cross-context basis rejects. This envelope cannot represent Attempt CREATED→STARTED, NF02 admission/result acceptance effects, Lane/Stage COMPLETION_ACCEPTED, Campaign GENESIS_ACCEPTED or CAMPAIGN_CONCLUDED. Those effects require the respective dedicated artifact/event contract and full predicates. CANCELLED/CLOSED/blocked/ready/running transitions retain all original purpose-specific guards; syntactic edge legality alone is insufficient. No fallback transition or invented state is added.

The event sequence is generated deterministically: artifact events in canonical object topological order, followed by requested independently legal transitions in payload order. The stored payload events and CommitBody.ordered_event_bodies must equal this derivation. Each artifact has exactly one corresponding acceptance event; no duplicated transition effect. Creation/default state and accepted artifact effects derive only from exact pinned transition semantics. Event bodies contain no accepting commit hash, own ordinal, own head or future receipt. Effective event identity remains the external `(accepting_commit_hash,ordinal)` tuple. Command payload may describe same-commit fact refs, but an event cannot use them to bootstrap a prior-only authority.

IsolationQualification/ContaminationAssessment successor scope is a nonempty ScopeSet of exact source-bound surface/key/invariant/coverage/scope-state subjects. Attempt/channel coverage derives additionally from their prior exact Attempt/Executor/Delivery/channel inventory fields. A broad or empty caller dictionary cannot stand for all channels. Missing material channel proof stays UNKNOWN/DECLARED; CLEAN/ENFORCED still require the original complete independent witness predicates.

Required vectors: unknown command/event; extra payload instruction; serialized trusted/token flag; wrong artifact event target; payload/commit event mismatch; duplicate event/effect; future command/receipt ref; generic transition START/completion/finalization bypass; stale aggregate parent; wrong prior basis; same-commit binding/start; direct ingestion dispatch without trusted boundary. Every negative canonical operation is REJECT plus no canonical mutation.
